hero.title: Join Us!
hero.description: Develop your skills, make great friends, and gain practical experience through real projects.

benefits.title: Why join Lapikud?
benefits.subtitle: Here are a few reasons why our community is a great place to grow

items.title: Practical projects
items.description: Work on real software projects and gain experience you don't get from classes alone.

items.title: Strong community
items.description: Join friendly and ambitious students, find your team, and build lasting friendships.

items.title: Mentorship
items.description: Get guidance from experienced students and developers, and improve faster.

items.title: Events
items.description: Take part in exciting events, hackathons, and trainings to expand your network.

items.title: Thesis opportunities
items.description: Interesting thesis topics grow from our projects. Find your topic and supervisor with us.

items.title: Work experience
items.description: Active members can gain their first paid work experience through our projects.

items.title: Software development:
items.description: Work on real projects with modern technologies and learn team collaboration and quality practices.

items.title: Helpdesk:
items.description: Help students and lecturers solve IT issues while improving your technical and communication skills.

items.title: Project management:
items.description: Take responsibility for project coordination and learn planning, leadership, and client communication.

items.title: Marketing and design:
items.description: Support project and event promotion, create social content, design materials, and track results.
